Product-Design-Execution Triangle
hyperedges.description: MSITest product defines the goal (AI testing platform), DESIGN.md defines the visual system (Flight Deck), Playwright provides the execution engine. The product vision shapes both the design language and the technology choice.

hyperedges.label: Convex Component Architecture Knowledge
hyperedges.description: The convex-create-component skill encapsulates the full knowledge graph of building reusable Convex components: function handles for cross-boundary callbacks, globals tables for config, class wrappers for published APIs. All patterns enforce the same boundary discipline: auth/env in app, IDs as strings, no direct client access.

hyperedges.label: Anti-AI-Visual Identity System
hyperedges.description: Both PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md explicitly reject AI visual cliches (sparkles, gradients, chatbot cards). The AI Insight Card is the only component with a non-neutral tint, deliberately subtle. This is a cross-cutting design constraint that affects every component containing AI-generated content.
Hybrid component pattern combines local and packaged component approaches
Widen-migrate-narrow workflow uses migrations component with migrateOne callback
Performance audit skill routes signals to four reference problem classes
Hot path optimization: push filters to storage via indexes, avoid redundant indexes
Field isolation and hot document splitting are related patterns across subscription cost and OCC conflict domains
Auth0 provider setup chain: Auth0Provider + ConvexProviderWithAuth0 wrapping with auth.config.ts
Clerk auth provider wiring chain within the setup auth skill
Convex Auth setup requires init command, authTables in schema, and ConvexAuthProvider wrapping
Failure analysis fixture provides rootCause, suggestedFix, and confidenceScore for AI failure analysis tests

hyperedges.rationale: ADRs 0001-0007 form a sequential architectural decision chain for MSITest's test execution and AI systems
Issues 001→002→003→004 form the foundation dependency chain: auth→schema→projects→suites/tests
BYOK config from onboarding feeds into both AI agent (ADR 0003) and Stagehand browser automation (ADR 0004/0005)
Three AI agents defined in issue 005 are consumed by issues 007 (PRD gen uses TestGen), 008 (NL gen uses TestGen), 014 (exploration uses Analysis+TestGen)
Runner execution pipeline: trigger→config→execute→report→heartbeat→aggregate→analyze failures with AI
Issues 011-015 all depend on issue 010 (aggregation+AI insights) which depends on 009 (runner execution)
Stagehand exploration pipeline: install SDK (022) → configure test data (023) → build smart explorer (024) → define output schema (025) → build user review UX (026)
Team collab foundation (019) enables resource locking which is required by non-blocking generation + task tray (020)
Live DOM context system: Runner Browser API serves aria snapshots from managed browser sessions, Convex client fetches them for AI operations

hyperedges.relation: Stagehand test execution and self-healing pipeline: hybrid format → Stagehand executor → auto-heal → learned healing persistence + cached login flows
Exploration and visualization chain: autonomous explorer with agent() → PRD-informed exploration with coverage reporting → feature map graph visualization of discovered flows
Phase 5 polish: browser AI model override settings, removal of deprecated browser-api/browser-sessions, Convex Stagehand component for lightweight server-side tasks
Live DOM pipeline: Runner snapshot API → Convex snapshot client with caching → NL test generation verify loop, PRD multi-page crawl, exploration DOM refresh, test healing with live DOM
Stagehand integration 5-phase roadmap: Foundation → Smart Exploration → Hybrid Test Format & Execution → Self-Healing → Polish & Optimization
Platform features independent of Stagehand chain: scheduled monitoring/cron runs, test lists for cross-project grouping, natural language chat refinement for test editing
Shared MSITest UI design system: Airtable-inspired tokens (accent #1b61c9), sidebar navigation, status pills, failure cards — reused across all prototype pages
User onboarding flow: login (email/password + Google OAuth) → workspace creation wizard (name + AI config) → new project wizard (name, URL, PRD) → app exploration with flow discovery
PRD-driven prototype design: the mpj6yr6w-PRD spec defines all pages and components which are implemented as HTML prototypes using the shared design system
Run detail page components: split-panel layout with test list on left, step timeline with pass/fail states, screenshot viewer per step, and color-coded browser console panel on right
Next.js default static SVG assets: file icon, globe icon, Next.js logo, Vercel triangle logo, window/browser icon — boilerplate public directory assets

Test management and execution: suites list page with suite cards → suite detail with code editor/viewer for Playwright test review → runner test page fixture used as execution target in integration tests

hyperedges.label: Convex Component Architecture Knowledge
hyperedges.description: The convex-create-component skill encapsulates the full knowledge graph of building reusable Convex components: function handles for cross-boundary callbacks, globals tables for config, class wrappers for published APIs. All patterns enforce the same boundary discipline: auth/env in app, IDs as strings, no direct client access.

hyperedges.label: Anti-AI-Visual Identity System
hyperedges.description: Both PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md explicitly reject AI visual cliches (sparkles, gradients, chatbot cards). The AI Insight Card is the only component with a non-neutral tint, deliberately subtle. This is a cross-cutting design constraint that affects every component containing AI-generated content.
